records.text: Owens said “allegedly” that she was told Michael McCoy gatekept the will appointment, which had been canceled once or twice and was finally scheduled in Arizona for the Monday after Charlie Kirk’s death. The informant’s identity and proximity are unverified.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I will also tell you now, and I will say allegedly, but I was told that Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) Gate kept that appointment and they had canceled it once or twice before, but it was finally scheduled to happen in Arizona on that Monday.
